name: Stephen Thaler
abstract_title:
Intrinsic Evaluation and Concept Stabilization in Self-Referential Neural Networks
--When generation and judgment converge, self-awareness begins.
abstract: This study proposes a computational model of consciousness grounded in the internal self-evaluation of generative neural systems. Unlike architectures that separate generation and criticism, the design embeds evaluative feedback directly within the same neural substrate. Distributed modules form hypergraph structures linking multimodal associations, while “hot buttons,” representing high-salience memory traces, regulate the consolidation of meaning.
